content.title: KRT Q3 Deep Dive: Margin Pressures and Product Expansion Shape Outlook
content.summary: Foodservice packaging supplier Karat Packaging (NASDAQ:KRT) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 10.4% year on year to $124.5 million. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $113.8 million, coming in 1.7% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.37 per share was 5.1% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
